texts.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: Banish (face-down) the top 4 cards of your Deck. You can only use each of the following effects of "Xenovader△ of Scarlet Naraka" once per turn. If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s) (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 of your face-down banished Level 5 or higher "Xenovader△" monsters, also you cannot activate cards or effects for the rest of this turn, except "Xenovader△" cards or effects.
texts.name: Xenovader△ of Scarlet Naraka
